notes.title: Death or Treat OUT NOW!! - Halloween comes early
notes.content:
Today is the big day, [b]Halloween comes early.👻[/b]

Join Scary on this adventure through a world inspired by [b]The Nightmare Before Christmas and Tim Burton [/b]where you will have to face social networks and a great enemy, Clark Fackerberg, who has stolen all the illusion of the inhabitants of this world through his famous drug Storyum.

4 totally distinctive worlds, with frenetic combat rhythms, a huge variety of weapons and charismatic characters make Death or Treat a game that you cannot miss.

Learn how to move, move fast, dodge enemies or use the type of combat that best suits you as a player, in addition to developing Necrosoft magic! 😏

Join HallowTown citiziens: [b]Joe Bite Them, Pumpkin Jobs, Pumpkin Gates[/b] and many others in this hand-painted rogue-like.

We invite you to enter the spooky and loving world of Death or Treat!


We are very happy to finally release Death or Treat, it has been a long and hard work but finally here we are and we hope you all like it.

🎃Happy “Halloween” 🎃

notes.title: Death or Treat - New Dev Stream
notes.content: Join us in this new opportunity to save HallowTown from Clark Fackerberg

notes.title: Death or Treat: Demo Stream. Let's save HallowTown!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! And welcome to our first Death or Treat stream.

We'll play the demo for a bit while answering all your questions and sharing our common love for videogames!

[previewyoutube=FvQjyoQ4LG0;full][/previewyoutube]

The Halloween spirit is missing! Play as Scary and help him save HallowTown. "Death or Treat" is a 2D action-roguelite and hack & slash, with handpainted environments and traditional animation. Explore all the worlds and defeat hordes of enemies using different weapons and skills.

Want to know more? Do not hesitate to play our demo!
